title: Decoding Alignment: A Critical Survey of LLM Development Initiatives through Value-setting and Data-centric Lens
reasoning: The paper centers on the 'value-setting' and ethical frameworks (such as Helpfulness, Harmlessness, and Honesty) used to align LLMs. It audits how corporate initiatives define and operationalize these morals and values, making ethics a core component of the study rather than a secondary consideration.
